title: Reading Drill — A Microphone in the Meeting Room
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Microphone in the Meeting Room
passages.body:
**A** A neighbourhood forum wanted recordings that people could understand at home. The first microphone captured the chair clearly but barely recorded people sitting next to the entrance. Raising its volume also recorded passing buses.

**B** The forum compared two different table positions during a short practice meeting. Placing the microphone in the centre helped by reducing the distance to speakers who had previously been quiet on the recording.

**C** The group added a simple rule. People were asked to give their names before speaking, which helped the person preparing the minutes identify the speakers when voices sounded similar.
